description: Extract text from a web page or PDF as clean Markdown — HTML to Markdown for any URL: strips scripts, nav, ads, and boilerplate while preserving headings, links, lists, tables, code blocks, and blockquotes; extracts the text layer from PDFs. Returns the Markdown body, title, word count, and a quality grade. For JavaScript-rendered or bot-walled pages a plain fetch can't read, use netintel_exa_contents instead.
name: netintel_web
